# fct_quoted_rates

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_quoted_rates` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Rates for Bookable Quotes, which are created by advisors in Portal for their clients to book. Includes information about the supplier, program, booking channel, pricing (USD and local currency), and lead time metrics. Each row is a single quoted rate. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `quoted_rate_id` | Primary Key, Unique identifier for each rate on a Bookable Quote >> SOURCE - Portal DB data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID of the advisor (user) in the Portal DB >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `bookable_quote_caption` | Caption written by advisors and associated to a Bookable Quote in Portal >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `bookable_quote_created_at` | When the Bookable Quote was created >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `bookable_quote_id` | Foreign Key. Identifier for each Bookable Quote in Portal >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `bookable_quote_name` | Name associated to a Bookable Quote in portal >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `bookable_quote_updated_at` | When the quote was updated >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `certification_when_bookable_quote_created` | The estimated certification level of the advisor when the Bookable Quote was created. This uses an approximate date of certification based on history table in Eastern Time ('America/New_York'), which may cause the dates to be off by 1-2 days.  >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `booked_by_type` | Indicates if a quoted rate was booked by a client or an advisor (when the rate has been booked) >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `booking_channel_id` | Foreign Key to the booking channel in Portal >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `booking_channel_name` | Name of the booking channel associated with the quoted rate >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `booking_id` | Foreign Key. Identifier for each booking record >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `booking_uuid` | UUID version of the booking_id >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `client_id` | Foreign Key. Identifies the client associated with the Bookable Quote >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `days_bookable_quote_created_to_booked` | Number of days from the Bookable Quote Created At date to the Booking Created At date for a Booking in the Quote >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_bookable_quote_created_to_first_booked` | Number of days from the Bookable Quote Created At date to the Booking Created At date for the first Booking in the Quote >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_bookable_quote_created_to_start` | Number of days between the date a Bookable Quote was created and the start date of the quoted rate (i.e., start date of the potential booking) >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `days_quoted_rate_created_to_start` | Number of days between the date a quoted rate was created and the start date of the quoted rate (i.e., start date of the potential booking) >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `days_start_to_end` | Number of days between start and end date of a quoted rate (i.e., length of stay) >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `days_unbooked_quote_active` | Number of days that an unbooked quote has been active for (i.e. the days between the Quote Created At date and today for quotes with no booking) >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `end_date` | The end date of the quoted rate, such as the checkout date at a hotel >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `first_booked_date` | The earliest 'Created Date' across all Bookings from the Quote >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `fx_rate_per_usd` | The foreign exchange rate to convert from local currency to USD. Multiply the local currency by this rate to get USD  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_archived_bookable_quote` | Whether the Bookable Quote has been archived in the Portal DB >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `is_archived_quoted_rate` | Whether the quoted rate has been archived in the Portal DB >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `is_booked_quoted_rate` | Whether the quoted rate has been booked >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `is_package_rate` | Whether the quoted rate is a package rate >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `number_of_adults` | Number of adults that a rate was quoted for >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `number_of_children` | Number of children associated with a quoted rate >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `original_quoted_currency` | Currency that the rate was quoted in >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `original_quoted_price_local` | Original price of a quoted rate in the quoted currency (this may be different to the booked price) >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `original_quoted_price_usd` | Original price of a quoted rate in USD (this may be different to the booked price) >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `program_id` | Foreign Key. Identifier for each supplier program in Portal >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `program_name` | Name of the supplier program associated to a quoted rate >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `quoted_rate_created_at` | When the rate in a quote was quoted >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `quoted_rate_description` | Description associated with a quoted rate >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `quoted_rate_display_order` | The position that a rate is ordered within a quote. This changes if advisors re-order rates within a quote >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `quoted_rate_personalized_message` | Personalized message for clients written by advisors and associated to a Bookable Quote >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `quoted_rate_title` | Title written by advisors and associated to a quoted rate >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `quoted_rate_updated_at` | When the rate in a quote was updated >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `rate_code` | Access token to unlock Travelport's inventory (null for providers that don't use this) >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `rate_code_id` | Identifier in Travelport in reference to the rate_code (null for providers that don't use this) >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `rate_id` | Identifier used to look up a rate in the external provider system (booking_code for Travelport, RateIdentifierKey for Zentrumhub)  >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `rate_unavailability_detected_at` | When a quoted rate is detected as no longer being available >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `rate_unavailability_notified_at` | When advisors are notified that a quoted rate is no longer available >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `start_date` | The start date of the quoted rate, such as the check-in date at a hotel >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `supplier_id` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for each supplier in the Portal DB >> SOURCE - Portal DB |
| `trip_id` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for each Trip record associated with a Bookable Quote. >>  SOURCE - Portal |
